moments.text: Wide infrared view toward the horizon under banded cloud, with a magenta crosshair; black redaction boxes cover the screen text.
The picture breaks up into green and grey blocks for about 15 s, then clears.
After a white flash the view narrows to plain grey; a tiny white dot wanders around the frame as the sensor slews.
A magenta box grows out from the crosshair; the dot sits inside it, lower right, then drifts out to the right.
A small bracket gate closes around the dot, and the sensor holds it just left of the crosshair.
The dot slides onto the crosshair centre; the background turns lighter from 4:28 to 4:33.
Green and grey blocks break up the picture again; the bright spot stays on the crosshair.
The view zooms in (corner marks vanish) as the background flashes light: the spot is now larger, with a soft glow.
The view widens again (corner marks return) and the spot shrinks to a faint dot on the crosshair.
Background turns pale grey with the faint dot on the crosshair; from 6:48 it darkens and the dot dims to grey.
A small black redaction box sits just right of the crosshair for about 10 s.
The crosshair markings change, a dark frame flickers, and the clip ends on darker grey with a cloud edge at the bottom.

notes: Heavy compression damage (block artefacts 10-12 s, 60-75 s, 4:35-4:40); redaction boxes over HUD text.
